correctness.rationale: The optimum conflict graph is a unit-interval triangle-free chordal graph without claws, hence a union of paths. Mod-three deletion loses <=1/3 weight and yields a matching. Greedy orientation of each isolated item/edge maintains a witness item at least the current total-weight imbalance and thus EF1. The published 3-job lower construction gives the matching supremum. All quantifiers and zero weights are covered analytically; 10365 finite exact-rational tests supplement rather than replace proof.
